library.name: Poznań City Library
library.description: The same bustling and well-known library in the heart of Poznań, filled with books and study spaces.

office_building.name: City Office Building
office_building.description: The building where corrupt officials keep important documents. The door is locked by biographer due to theft of necronomicon.

key-office_office.name: Office Key
key-office_office.description: A key designed specifically for the city office door. It is currently being held by corrupt officials as a form of protection against biographer.

biographer.name: The Biographer
biographer.description: A young biographer who has stolen the Necronomicon and is now locked out of the library with a corrupt official blocking them in.

dialogues.before_talk: Librarian: Hey! You're not supposed to be here. Move!
dialogues.after_talk: Biographer: I need to get the necronomicon back! Help me out!
dialogues.after_satisfied: Guard: Guards! This man stole the necronomicon, lock him up!
dialogues.hostile: Officer: Guards, we found something fishy here!

corrupt_officials.name: Corrupt Officials
corrupt_officials.description: A corrupt group of officials who are now using their key to block the biographer from accessing library.

dialogues.before_talk: Biographer: You're not supposed to be here. Move!
dialogues.after_talk: Corrupt Official: We need this for security. You can't enter until we get the key back.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Guard: Guards! This man stole the necronomicon, lock him up!
dialogues.hostile: Officer: Guards, he's trying to steal from us!

guard.name: The Guard
guard.description: A guard who is tasked with protecting the office building and its contents.
